messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the person's one-piece garment with the item shown in the reference images (front and back views). Keep all other clothing, footwear, and non-clothing attributes unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please select the version from before the first action change was made and apply the following edit to that version: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the person's one-piece garment with the item shown in the reference images. Keep all other clothing, footwear, and non-clothing attributes unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The woman stands in the center of the frame, initially facing forward, then turns her body to the right and back to the left, looking around the environment.","camera":"The camera is at a low angle, looking up at the subject, and remains mostly static with slight adjustments as she moves.","clothing":"She wears a white, sleeveless, crocheted dress with a fitted bodice and a long skirt, along with a grey, textured shawl draped around her neck and dark sandals.","hair_color":"Brown.","hairstyle":"Her hair is styled in two small buns on top of her head with bangs framing her face.","identity":"A young woman with a slim build, light skin, and a neutral facial expression.","scene":"The setting is an indoor corridor with a polished tiled floor, a large wall clock, and a textured orange pillar on the right."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The original dark black lace one-piece dress was replaced with a white sleeveless crocheted dress with a fitted bodice and long skirt, matching the reference garment. The grey shawl, dark sandals, hairstyle, identity, scene, and camera behavior remain largely consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the person's one-piece garment with the white sleeveless crocheted dress shown in the reference images, keeping all other clothing, footwear, and non-clothing attributes unchanged.
uncertain: Fine lace pattern details on the new dress are not fully verifiable against the reference at all moments due to lighting and motion.
unexpected_changes: The output frames appear slightly narrower/cropped compared with the source frames.
